creators.name: Keijiro Takahashi
creators.role: Creative coder; developer advocate at Unity Technologies Japan
creators.bio: Unity Japan engineer who open-sources hundreds of real-time VFX, depth-camera and ML-tracking experiments on GitHub and uses them in live concert visuals.
creators.why: His Rcam/Bibcam/Metavido line turned the iPhone LiDAR into a volumetric AR camera for live VFX, and every experiment ships with source code students can run.

creators.name: Trixi Studios (Chip Sineni)
creators.role: Chicago VFX / AR studio led by Chip Sineni
creators.bio: Small animation and VFX studio that built early Project Tango and ARKit experiments, including the viral a-ha 'Take On Me' AR portal.
creators.why: Its 'Take On Me' portal (2017) showed that phone AR could reproduce a hand-drawn music-video world you can walk into, live in camera.

creators.name: Stuart Langfield
creators.bio: Film and motion director whose 2017 Super Mario AR test rethought a side-scroller as a ring-shaped level wrapped around the player.
creators.why: His Super Mario AR prototype is a textbook case of redesigning a 2D game format for the space around the player instead of porting it flat.

creators.name: Jelle Vermandere
creators.bio: Belgian maker who builds mixed-reality games that use real objects and his body as controllers: a real football, RC cars, a smart Rubik's cube, a heart-rate monitor.
creators.why: He shows, step by step on YouTube, how computer vision and cheap hardware turn everyday objects into game controllers for AR-style play.

creators.name: Tomás García
creators.role: Animator, character designer and AI artist
creators.bio: Argentine animator (ex-PepperMelon, MTV redesign) whose June 2017 ARKit tests of a moon landing in his kitchen and a Falcon 9 landing in a pool went viral in the first weeks of ARKit.
creators.why: His playful ARKit sketches showed how animation craft plus a correct sense of scale makes phone AR feel magical.

creators.name: Can Büyükberber
creators.bio: Turkish-born artist working with projection mapping, domes, VR and AR; Adobe's immersive artist in residence and an early ARKit experimenter.
creators.why: He moves the same generative sculptures across projection, print, dome, VR and AR, a clear model of how one visual idea can live in many realities.

creators.name: Judith Amores
creators.role: Researcher (MIT Media Lab PhD; Microsoft Research)
creators.bio: HCI researcher who built playful AR prototypes from Barcelona to MIT Media Lab and Google Creative Lab, and multi-person AR at Microsoft Research with Jaron Lanier.
creators.why: Co-author of three of Google's 2017 AR Experiments (Draw and Dance, Paper Cubes, Invisible Highway), each a compact, teachable AR interaction idea.

creators.name: Anna Fusté
creators.role: Creative technologist and researcher (MIT Media Lab alumna)
creators.bio: Catalan creative technologist whose AR work uses paper, textiles and robots as tangible interfaces, from Google AR Experiments to MIT Media Lab research on computational thinking.
creators.why: She keeps making AR out of cheap physical materials (paper cubes, fabrics, toy robots), which is exactly what classrooms can reproduce.

creators.name: Aidan Wolf
creators.role: AR developer; co-founder of Dream Park
creators.bio: Long-time Snap AR developer who made DoodleLens (doodles into AR), multiplayer Snapchat lenses and Spectacles games, and now builds 'downloadable' mixed-reality theme parks with Dream Park.
creators.why: He turns every new AR capability into a playful, instantly shareable game, from doodles that come alive to whole streets turned into playgrounds.

creators.name: Alessio Grancini
creators.role: AR engineer; Snap Spectacles developer relations (ex-Magic Leap, Morphosis)
creators.bio: Italian architect turned AR prototyper: SCI-Arc Gehry Prize thesis on a world-scale AR game, XR lead at Morphosis, prototype engineer at Magic Leap, now building and teaching Spectacles lenses at Snap.
creators.why: He carries architectural thinking into AR and ships a constant stream of hackathon prototypes that pair spatial computing with AI.

creators.name: Luke Hurd
creators.role: AR effects creator and educator (Spark AR, Lens Studio)
creators.bio: Early Instagram/Spark AR effect creator and teacher whose YouTube breakdowns explained face-mesh, occlusion and segmentation tricks; later built branded AR for National Geographic/NASA JPL and Coachella.
creators.why: He made social-AR craft legible, publishing full breakdowns of how his viral effects actually work.

creators.name: Torin Blankensmith
creators.role: Creative technologist, real-time graphics artist, Parsons adjunct
creators.bio: Ex-Google Creative Lab technologist (co-built AR Wormhole) and co-creator of Shader Park; his free MediaPipe and body-tracking plugins for TouchDesigner put camera-based body interaction in thousands of students' hands.
creators.why: He turns webcam hand and body tracking into open tools and short, remixable mixed-reality sketches that are ideal for teaching.

creators.name: Fabin Rasheed
creators.bio: Indian artist-designer who prototyped ARKit sculpting, multiplayer AR and AR drone control in 2017-18, presented an Adobe MAX Sneak, and now makes generative art.
creators.why: His early ARKit tools treated the phone as a sculpting and play space, and he keeps moving between interaction design and art.

creators.name: Hart Woolery (2020CV)
creators.bio: Computer-vision developer whose company 2020CV trained its own mobile hand, face and pet tracking models to make InstaSaber, YoPuppet, SpeakingPuppy and Snap lenses.
creators.why: He built phone hand tracking years before platforms shipped it, and wrapped it in instantly fun ideas like a paper-tube lightsaber and hand puppets.

creators.name: Sallia Goldstein
creators.role: Technical artist and Snap Lens Creator
creators.bio: LA-based 3D technical artist whose career began with a viral Snapchat lens; she has built lenses for Coachella, UFC and LACMA and teaches in Snap's Lens Academy.
creators.why: Her body-tracked VFX lenses show how far simple template tweaks and restraint can go in social AR.

creators.name: Velvet Spectrum (Luke & Morgan Choice)
creators.bio: Studio of Australian visual artist Luke Choice and Morgan Choice, known for colorful 3D typography, who extended their work into Snapchat lenses and Adobe Aero AR pieces.
creators.why: They show how an illustration/motion studio can translate its visual language into playful AR without heavy engineering.

creators.name: Phil Walton
creators.role: Official Snap Lens Creator and author
creators.bio: Lens creator behind the viral 'Potato Boss' lens and author of The Designer's Guide to Snapchat's Lens Studio.
creators.why: His Potato Boss lens proved that the simplest face-AR joke can travel worldwide.

creators.name: Christian Marclay
creators.bio: Swiss-American artist known for sound and collage works such as The Clock, who created an audio AR lens for the Centre Pompidou with Snap.
creators.why: He used AR not for visuals but to turn a whole museum into a playable musical instrument.

works.title: Rcam at Channel #20 (live with umio)
works.description: A depth camera on stage streams a volumetric point cloud of the performer into Unity, where VFX Graph particles dissolve and rebuild her body in real time for a live concert.
works.idea_zh: 把舞台上的人实时扫成点云，再让粒子把人拆散、重组，成为现场演出的视觉。
works.technique: A RealSense depth camera sends color+depth frames to Unity, which converts them into a point cloud that drives VFX Graph particles projected behind the performer.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Kinect/手机深度或 MediaPipe 人体分割把一位同学变成粒子剪影投影在墙上；加一个变化：音乐音量越大粒子越散。

works.title: Rcam2: Volumetric AR camera rig
works.description: An iPad Pro LiDAR rig streams color, depth and camera pose to a PC, where Unity wraps the real scene in glowing particle and line effects that stay locked to the room.
works.idea_zh: 把 iPad 的 LiDAR 当成可移动的体积摄像机，让特效贴着真实房间长出来。
works.technique: ARKit on an iPad Pro captures LiDAR depth, color and camera pose, streams them over NDI to a PC, and Unity reprojects the depth into world space to spawn VFX Graph effects.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Reality Composer 或 Unity AR Foundation 的 mesh 扫描，让粒子沿着真实墙面和家具流动；加一个变化：只在你指过的物体表面发光。

works.title: Bibcam test in Shibuya
works.description: Street footage shot on an iPhone 13 Pro Max records depth and camera motion inside the video itself, so later the crossing in Shibuya can be re-lit and filled with 3D effects.
works.idea_zh: 录像时把深度和相机位姿一起'烙'进视频，之后就能给街景补上贴合空间的特效。
works.technique: Bibcam encodes the LiDAR depth map and camera pose as metadata burned into each recorded video frame, so Unity can later reconstruct the 3D scene for post-processed AR VFX.
works.exercise_zh: 用带 LiDAR 的手机录一段校园短片（或用 Record3D 导出），在 Unity/Blender 里给真实空间补上下雪或发光线条；加一个变化：特效只出现在离镜头 2 米之外。

works.title: Adding VFX to a Bibcam clip
works.description: A recorded Bibcam walk is post-processed so that particles and light trails wrap around the real buildings and people, with the effect following the real depth of the street.
works.idea_zh: 对一段已录好的深度视频做'空间感知'的后期特效。
works.technique: Depth and pose embedded in the video let VFX Graph sample the real geometry per frame, so particles can spawn on and collide with surfaces in the footage.
works.exercise_zh: 把一段深度视频导入 TouchDesigner，用深度通道控制粒子密度，让近处的人变成光点；加一个变化：粒子颜色随时间从白天过渡到夜晚。

works.title: VFX with Unity AR Foundation
works.description: Live on an iPhone, glowing particles and lines grow over the real room and people in front of the camera, anchored to the LiDAR-scanned environment.
works.idea_zh: 直接在手机上实时让光效沿真实环境生长。
works.technique: AR Foundation exposes the LiDAR environment depth and human stencil textures, which VFX Graph samples on-device to emit particles from real surfaces.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 或 Lens Studio 的深度纹理，让房间表面冒出萤火虫；加一个变化：人走过的地方萤火虫会散开。

works.title: Walking a Taiwanese street with iPhone LiDAR
works.description: A night walk through a street in Taiwan is visualized as a sparse point-cloud world built live from the iPhone LiDAR, showing both the magic and the 5-meter range limit of the sensor.
works.idea_zh: 用 LiDAR 的'看不远'这一缺陷，本身做成一种梦境般的街景风格。
works.technique: LiDAR depth samples are reprojected into world-space points each frame and accumulated, so the scene is reconstructed as a trail of colored points around the walker.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Polycam/Scaniverse 扫一条走廊，导出点云并用 three.js 只显示离你 5 米内的点；加一个变化：点云随脚步声闪烁。

works.title: Rcam3 for Masaya Matsuura's concert
works.description: A fixed iPhone on stage captures the performers' depth, and Unity turns their silhouettes into large-scale VFX shown behind the band during Masaya Matsuura's concert.
works.idea_zh: 把手机 LiDAR 当成舞台上的体积摄像头，实时生成演出视觉。
works.technique: An iPhone controller app streams color and LiDAR depth to a host PC, where the depth is converted to point positions that drive VFX Graph for projection.
works.exercise_zh: 用一台手机拍乐手，在 TouchDesigner 里把人体轮廓转成粒子投影到身后；加一个变化：鼓点触发粒子爆开。

works.title: Metavido VFX (WebGPU)
works.description: Volumetric clips captured with an iPhone Pro play back in a web browser, where the recorded person and space are re-rendered as particles and effects in 3D.
works.idea_zh: 把手机拍的'带深度的视频'放进网页，任何人都能在浏览器里围着它看特效。
works.technique: Metavido stores LiDAR depth and camera metadata inside a standard video stream, which a Unity WebGPU build decodes to reconstruct points for VFX in the browser.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Record3D 或手机深度视频导入 three.js，在网页里把一段舞蹈重建成点云；加一个变化：观众点击后切换成'沙子'材质坍塌。

works.title: HandPoseBarracuda hand tracker
works.description: A single webcam tracks all finger joints in real time inside Unity, drawing a 3D hand skeleton over the live image as a building block for gesture-driven effects.
works.idea_zh: 只用普通摄像头就能在 Unity 里拿到手指关节，做手势特效的基础件。
works.technique: MediaPipe palm-detection and hand-landmark neural networks run on the GPU through Unity Barracuda to output 21 3D keypoints per frame.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe Hands（网页版即可）追踪手指，让指尖在摄像头画面上拖出彩色光带；加一个变化：捏合手指时光带变成可抓的绳子。

works.title: FaceMeshBarracuda face & eye tracker
works.description: A webcam face and iris tracker running in Unity overlays a dense face mesh and eye landmarks on the live video, ready for mask and gaze effects.
works.idea_zh: 在 Unity 里用一个摄像头实现脸部网格与眼球追踪，做面具和视线特效。
works.technique: MediaPipe face-mesh and iris models run via Barracuda to return 468 face vertices plus iris landmarks, which are used to texture and deform an overlay mesh.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Spark/Lens Studio 或 MediaPipe FaceMesh 做一个跟着眼球转动的'第三只眼'面具；加一个变化：眨眼时面具换一张脸。

works.title: BodyPix visual effects (NNCam)
works.description: A webcam segments the person from the background and body parts in real time, so particles, outlines and glitches can wrap only the human body in the live image.
works.idea_zh: 实时把人从背景里'抠'出来，特效只作用在人身上。
works.technique: The BodyPix person-and-part segmentation network runs through Unity Barracuda, and its mask texture is used to emit and confine VFX Graph particles to the body.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe Selfie Segmentation 或 TouchDesigner 把同学的身体变成流动的墨水而背景保持不动；加一个变化：只有举起的手会燃烧。

works.title: Holographic ribbons for VRDG+H
works.description: A floating statue and ribbons appear as virtual images in mid-air using a holographic optical setup, animated to DUB-Russell's music at the VRDG+H show.
works.idea_zh: 用光学'虚像'让 Unity 做的雕像和缎带悬浮在空中随音乐舞动。
works.technique: Unity renders are shown through a holographic / Pepper's-ghost-style optical element so the image is perceived as a virtual image floating in space (likely a half-mirror or holographic screen).
works.exercise_zh: 用一块斜放的透明亚克力和手机屏幕做佩珀尔幻象，让一个 3D 小雕像悬浮；加一个变化：拍手时缎带绕着它旋转。

works.title: Augmented Reality's A-ha Moment (Take On Me AR portal)
works.description: A door-sized portal in a real living room opens into the pencil-sketch world of a-ha's 'Take On Me'; stepping inside turns everything, including your own hand, into rotoscoped comic lines while real kids dance outside.
works.idea_zh: 穿过一道门就走进 a-ha《Take On Me》的铅笔漫画世界，连自己的手也变成线稿。
works.technique: An ARKit-anchored portal uses a stencil/depth mask so the sketch world renders only through the doorway, and a line-art shader restyles the camera feed once you cross it.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Reality Composer/Unity 做一扇传送门，里面是一张手绘线稿全景；加一个变化：进门后给摄像头画面加上描边滤镜，让现实也变成漫画。

works.title: Gate to the Upside Down
works.description: A Stranger Things-inspired ARKit test turns an ordinary pharmacy aisle into the dark, spore-filled 'Upside Down', with the real space darkened and overgrown around the camera.
works.idea_zh: 把超市货架变成《怪奇物语》的颠倒世界。
works.technique: The camera feed is color-graded dark while floating particles and vine meshes are anchored to ARKit-detected planes to make the real room feel replaced.
works.exercise_zh: 选一个熟悉的教室角落，用滤镜+漂浮粒子+贴地藤蔓把它变成'另一个平行世界'；加一个变化：手机靠近某个真实物体时世界切回现实。

works.title: PHANTOGEIST
works.description: A first-person shooter on a Project Tango phone spawns ghostly enemies and environments around you anywhere, from a small room to a football field, with no markers.
works.idea_zh: 在任何真实场地里打第一人称幽灵射击，场地大小游戏自己适配。
works.technique: Tango's inside-out motion tracking gives 6DoF pose so enemies can be placed in world coordinates and the play area scales to the available physical space.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 做一个在操场上刷怪的小游戏，敌人从远处走来；加一个变化：只有把手机举高才能看到飞在空中的敌人。

works.title: PHANTOGEIST Co-op 'Automatic Mixed Reality'
works.description: Two Tango devices share the same ghost battle, so one player can film the other fighting virtual enemies, producing mixed-reality footage automatically.
works.idea_zh: 两台设备共享同一场战斗，一人玩、一人当'摄影师'，自动产出混合现实视频。
works.technique: Both devices localize into a shared coordinate frame (likely via Tango area learning) so enemies appear in the same physical place for each player.
works.exercise_zh: 用 8th Wall/Lens Studio 的多人共享或 ARKit 协作会话做一个双人游戏：一个人打怪，另一个人拍摄；加一个变化：摄影者的镜头可以'冻结'怪物。

works.title: Star Wars Mixed Reality Test
works.description: Recorded live on a Project Tango tablet, Star Wars ships and droids appear in a real room and hold their place as the camera walks around them.
works.idea_zh: 在真实房间里让星战机器人和飞船停在原地，你绕着它们走。
works.technique: Tango motion tracking plus depth sensing anchors 3D models to the room so they keep position and scale while the device moves.
works.exercise_zh: 把一个你喜欢的电影道具模型放进教室，绕着它录一段'纪录片'；加一个变化：靠近时模型会转头看你。

works.title: Super Mario AR
works.description: A Super Mario World level is bent into a ring around the player; you turn in place to follow Mario and reach out to grab power-ups floating in real space and drop them onto him.
works.idea_zh: 把横版马里奥关卡卷成一圈围着你，你转身跟着跑，还能伸手抓道具丢给马里奥。
works.technique: The level geometry is wrapped onto a cylinder centered on the ARKit world origin so rotating the phone scrolls the game, and a raycast pick lets you move items.
works.exercise_zh: 把一个 2D 小游戏的关卡'卷'成围着玩家的一圈（在 Unity 或 Reality Composer 里），玩家原地转身来推进；加一个变化：玩家必须蹲下才能看到隐藏关。

works.title: AR Boxing Game
works.description: He places virtual opponents in his real living room with AR Foundation and punches at them, turning a fitness routine into an AR boxing match.
works.idea_zh: 把陪练对手放进自家客厅，对着空气打拳也能健身。
works.technique: AR Foundation plane detection places the opponent on the floor and the phone's pose (held or strapped) is used to detect punches and dodges.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 在地上放一个会出拳的沙袋人，玩家侧身躲避；加一个变化：心率越高对手越强。

works.title: Controlling a Soccer Game with a Real Ball
works.description: A webcam tracks a real football and his body pose so kicking the actual ball drives a digital football match in Unity.
works.idea_zh: 踢真球，屏幕里的比赛跟着动。
works.technique: Python computer vision detects the ball position and the player's pose from a webcam and streams them to Unity, which maps them into the game world.
works.exercise_zh: 用网页摄像头+颜色追踪让一个真实的纸团控制屏幕里的弹球；加一个变化：纸团撞到墙上的某块纸板区域时触发进球动画。

works.title: Real Hole in the Wall Game
works.description: A full-body game based on Japan's Brain Wall: a webcam reads his pose and a heart-rate monitor adds pressure as walls with body-shaped holes rush toward him.
works.idea_zh: 根据《墙来了》：用身体摆出墙上洞的形状才能过关。
works.technique: MoveNet pose estimation extracts body keypoints from a webcam, which are compared against the silhouette of each incoming wall hole.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Teachable Machine 或 MoveNet 做一个'墙来了'：屏幕上出现姿势轮廓，同学要在 3 秒内摆出来；加一个变化：两个人合体才能过一面墙。

works.title: Turning RC Cars into Pets
works.description: Overhead computer vision tracks several Arduino-controlled RC cars in real time and gives each one a personality, so they roam the floor like pets that react to him.
works.idea_zh: 给遥控车装上'性格'，让它们像宠物一样在地上游走、回应你。
works.technique: A camera tracks each car with CV markers, and a behavior script sends steering commands back over radio so the physical cars act on virtual rules.
works.exercise_zh: 用 micro:bit 小车 + 头顶摄像头追踪，让小车'害怕'同学的脚并逃开；加一个变化：给每辆车一个投影在地上的情绪表情。

works.title: A Rubik's Cube Game with a Real Cube
works.description: A Bluetooth smart Rubik's cube becomes the controller: every real twist rotates and changes a puzzle world he built in Unity.
works.idea_zh: 拧真实的魔方来操控游戏世界。
works.technique: The GAN smart cube reports each face turn over Bluetooth, and Unity maps those moves to rotations of the in-game level.
works.exercise_zh: 用带陀螺仪的手机或 micro:bit 当'魔方'，转动它来旋转屏幕里的迷宫让小球滚到出口；加一个变化：摇一摇会让迷宫重新生成。

works.title: Moon Landing @ my Kitchen
works.description: The Apollo lunar module lands on his kitchen counter and astronauts step out, captured in real time with one of the first ARKit builds.
works.idea_zh: 阿波罗登月发生在厨房台面上。
works.technique: ARKit horizontal plane detection anchors an animated Unity scene to the countertop and keeps it stable as the phone moves.
works.exercise_zh: 把一个历史事件做成桌面大小的 AR 动画（Reality Composer 即可）放到课桌上；加一个变化：观众离近时出现解说字幕。

works.title: Moon Landing @ Living Room
works.description: A larger version of the moon-landing test fills the living room floor, with a real dog wandering past the out-of-scale astronauts.
works.idea_zh: 登月场景铺满客厅地板，真狗从宇航员身边走过。
works.technique: The same ARKit floor anchor is used with a scaled-up scene so real objects and pets walk through the virtual set.
works.exercise_zh: 把同一个 AR 场景做三种尺寸（手掌、桌面、房间）对比观感；加一个变化：让场景随真实宠物/同学的位置让路。

works.title: Falcon 9 landing in a swimming pool
works.description: A SpaceX Falcon 9 booster descends with fire and smoke and lands on a drone ship floating in his real swimming pool.
works.idea_zh: 猎鹰 9 号火箭回收降落在自家泳池里的无人船上。
works.technique: An ARKit plane on the water surface anchors a Unity-animated rocket, drone ship and particle exhaust at a deliberate miniature scale.
works.exercise_zh: 找一个校园里的真实平面（水池、操场、台阶），把一段科学新闻做成缩小版 AR 重演；加一个变化：观众可以用手势'倒计时'启动。

works.title: ARKit + Unity + Motion Capture: robot dancing
works.description: A robot character performs motion-captured dance moves in his living room, showing how real mocap data makes an AR character feel alive.
works.idea_zh: 用动捕数据让机器人在客厅里跳舞。
works.technique: A humanoid rig driven by recorded motion-capture clips is placed on an ARKit floor plane so the dance happens at human scale.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Mixamo 下载一段舞蹈动作绑到角色上，放进 AR 教室里；加一个变化：用手机麦克风的节拍控制播放速度。

works.title: Invisible exhibition at the de Young (ARKit experiment)
works.description: With Marpi, he placed generative 3D sculptures in the de Young Museum that are only visible through an iPad, an 'invisible exhibition' blurring what is real in the galleries.
works.idea_zh: 在美术馆里办一场只有透过手机才看得见的'隐形展览'。
works.technique: A custom ARKit/Unity app anchors animated generative meshes to detected floor planes so they appear as sculptures standing in the real gallery.
works.exercise_zh: 在学校走廊策划一个'隐形展'：每位同学用 Reality Composer 放一件只能用手机看到的作品；加一个变化：作品只在特定时间段出现。

works.title: Metafold 05, AR-activated digital print
works.description: A printed artwork from his Metafold series springs into an animated 3D sculpture when viewed through a phone, extending the static print into motion.
works.idea_zh: 一张静态版画，用手机一扫就长出会动的 3D 雕塑。
works.technique: Image-target tracking recognizes the print and overlays a registered animated 3D version on top of it (likely via an image-marker AR app).
works.exercise_zh: 把自己的一幅画当成图像识别标记（Artivive/Adobe Aero/8th Wall 都可），让画里的东西飞出来；加一个变化：从侧面看时显示画的'背面世界'。

works.title: Mixed Reality vs. Reality
works.description: Side-by-side POV captures compare playing ping-pong in Quest 3 passthrough mixed reality and with Ray-Ban Meta glasses in plain reality, noting how occlusion and gravity feel different.
works.idea_zh: 把同一个动作分别在混合现实和真实世界里做，对比两者的'物理感'。
works.technique: Quest 3 passthrough MR with scene understanding simulates the ball, while the glasses record the real throw for a direct comparison of occlusion and physics.
works.exercise_zh: 让同学同一动作（扔纸团进篮筐）在 AR 版本和真实版本里各做一次并并排剪辑；加一个变化：AR 版本里故意改变重力，让观众找不同。

works.title: Unfold 01 | Projection on Print
works.description: A morphogenesis-inspired form printed on a large canvas is overlaid with an exactly aligned projection, so the flat print seems to fold and breathe.
works.idea_zh: 投影精确叠在印刷画上，让平面图像像生物一样折叠、呼吸。
works.technique: A projector is calibrated to the printed canvas so animated light and shadow are registered on top of the matching printed geometry.
works.exercise_zh: 打印一张黑白几何图，用投影仪 + MadMapper/TouchDesigner 精确对位投上动画光影；加一个变化：动画跟随环境音乐节奏。

works.title: Unifield | Projection on Lasercut Sculpture
works.description: A laser-cut sculpture based on Coxeter's higher-dimensional geometry is projection-mapped so light seems to reveal a 4D object rotating through it.
works.idea_zh: 在激光切割雕塑上做投影映射，像一个四维物体在其中穿行。
works.technique: Projection mapping aligns rendered animation to the fabricated sculpture's facets so virtual light and motion appear to live on the physical form.
works.exercise_zh: 用纸板折一个多面体，投影映射让每个面依次亮起形成'旋转'错觉；加一个变化：观众走动时（用摄像头检测）光的旋转方向改变。

works.title: Draw and Dance
works.description: You draw a stick figure on your phone and it becomes a dancing AR character that reacts to music and sounds around it, even perching on a Google Home speaker to dance to its output.
works.idea_zh: 画一个火柴人，它就在现实中跟着周围的声音和音乐跳舞。
works.technique: A 2D drawing is rigged into a stick-figure skeleton, anchored with ARCore, and animated by microphone amplitude and voice commands via API.AI.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Scratch/p5.js 或 Lens Studio 让学生画的角色随麦克风音量跳舞并放到 AR 里；加一个变化：两个角色听到不同音高会跳不同舞步。

works.title: Invisible Highway
works.description: Draw a path on the floor in AR and a real robot car follows it through the room, while the phone adds a generated highway and scenery along the route.
works.idea_zh: 在 AR 里画一条路，真实的小车就沿着它开。
works.technique: The drawn AR path is converted to world coordinates via Tango tracking and sent as waypoints to a robot car whose position is tracked to follow it.
works.exercise_zh: 用平板在地上'画'一条 AR 路线，再让 micro:bit 小车按坐标开过去（可用摄像头俯拍追踪）；加一个变化：路上放虚拟障碍，小车要绕行。

works.title: Paper Cubes
works.description: Printable paper cubes become physical controllers for a crowd of AR stick figures: show a cube and the figures jump, turn or stop, and an 'AI cube' makes them smarter.
works.idea_zh: 用剪纸做的方块当遥控器，指挥 AR 小人跳、转、停。
works.technique: Each cube face is a Vuforia image target; the recognized face and cube pose trigger behaviors for AR characters walking over the table.
works.exercise_zh: 打印几个带图案的纸方块，用 8th Wall/Vuforia 识别，每个图案对应一种角色动作；加一个变化：两个方块靠近时组合成新指令。

works.title: HyperCubes
works.description: Children arrange paper cubes printed with markers as coding blocks; the phone reads the sequence and an AR character executes it in space, teaching computational thinking.
works.idea_zh: 把纸方块排成一串就是'程序'，AR 角色按顺序执行。
works.technique: Paper cubes act as fiducial markers whose order and spatial arrangement are read as a sequence of instructions, and the result is animated in AR.
works.exercise_zh: 做一套纸质'代码积木'（前进/转弯/跳），用手机识别顺序并让 AR 机器人走迷宫；加一个变化：加入'循环'积木。

works.title: Kinetic AR: robot motion programming in AR
works.description: Using a phone, you draw and edit a robot's motion path directly on the floor in AR and the physical robot follows it, making robot programming spatial and visual.
works.idea_zh: 直接在地上'画'出机器人的运动轨迹来编程。
works.technique: The AR interface tracks the robot and floor in a shared frame, and user-drawn spline paths are converted into motion commands sent to the robot.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机 AR 在地上放几个路径点，让扫地机器人/乐高小车按顺序经过；加一个变化：每个路径点可以设置'停下来跳舞'。

works.title: Reality Masher: multi-person AR
works.description: A Microsoft Research prototype with Jaron Lanier in which several people wearing early HoloLens headsets share and play with the same holograms in one room.
works.idea_zh: 多人戴头显，在同一个房间里共享同一批全息物体。
works.technique: Multiple HoloLens devices share a common spatial anchor so holograms occupy the same physical location for every participant.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Lens Studio Connected Lens 或 8th Wall 共享会话，让两台手机看到同一只虚拟宠物并轮流喂它；加一个变化：一人只能看到、另一人只能听到。

works.title: Qbox: AR Magic Toy
works.description: Put a small toy inside a box and, through an AR interface, it comes to life, interacting with the box, the child and the world around it.
works.idea_zh: 把玩具放进魔法盒，透过屏幕它就活了。
works.technique: Marker tracking on the box registers an animated virtual version of the inserted toy on top of the physical one (likely marker/toy recognition).
works.exercise_zh: 做一个贴有识别图的纸盒，放入不同玩具时（换不同卡片）AR 里出现不同动画；加一个变化：摇晃盒子会让角色晕倒。

works.title: Augmented Menu
works.description: A virtual AR waiter with automatic gestures, facial expressions and lip-sync appears at the table to present the daily menu and talk with diners.
works.idea_zh: 一个虚拟服务员出现在餐桌上，为你介绍今日菜单。
works.technique: An avatar anchored on a table marker is animated procedurally with gesture, head-look and lip-sync generated from the audio input.
works.exercise_zh: 做一张 AR 菜单卡：扫一下出现一个会说话的 3D 角色介绍菜品（Reality Composer + TTS）；加一个变化：角色会看向离它最近的人。

works.title: DoodleLens
works.description: Point your phone at a doodle on paper and it is lifted off the page into AR, inspired by an old camcorder chroma feature; later updates animate doodles like flipbooks and turn them into 3D models.
works.idea_zh: 对着纸上的涂鸦一拍，它就'撕'下来变成 AR 贴纸活过来。
works.technique: The camera image is thresholded to extract dark ink strokes into a transparent texture, which is placed on a billboard anchored in AR space.
works.exercise_zh: 用 p5.js 或 Lens Studio 把白纸上的涂鸦抠成透明贴图并放到 AR 里；加一个变化：连续拍四张涂鸦就组成一段逐帧动画。

works.title: DoodleLens flipbook animation
works.description: A series of doodles captured one after another plays back as a looping flipbook animation standing in the real world.
works.idea_zh: 把一叠涂鸦变成站在现实里的翻页动画。
works.technique: Each captured doodle becomes a frame in a sprite sequence that cycles on an AR-anchored quad.
works.exercise_zh: 让每位同学画一帧，拼成一段全班的逐帧动画放进 AR 教室；加一个变化：观众走近时播放速度变快。

works.title: Doodles into 3D models
works.description: A flat drawing is extruded into a chunky 3D object that can be placed and walked around in AR.
works.idea_zh: 把平面涂鸦'挤出'成可以绕着看的 3D 物体。
works.technique: The extracted doodle outline is triangulated and extruded into a mesh with the drawing as its front texture (likely contour extrusion).
works.exercise_zh: 在 Blender 或 three.js 里把一张手绘轮廓 SVG 挤出成 3D 并导入 AR；加一个变化：挤出厚度由画的颜色深浅决定。

works.title: Copy and paste into AR
works.description: Images and art copied on the phone are pasted straight into the surrounding space as AR objects, with no editing step.
works.idea_zh: 复制一张图，直接'粘贴'到现实空间里。
works.technique: Clipboard images are background-removed and spawned as textured quads at the AR raycast hit point.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个网页 AR（8th Wall/WebXR）：从相册选图后贴到墙上当'虚拟海报'；加一个变化：贴上的图会被其他同学看到并留言。

works.title: PONK connected lens
works.description: Two friends play classic Pong in AR, each hitting the ball from their own phone in a shared Snapchat lens.
works.idea_zh: 两个人在同一片现实空间里打 AR 版乒乓 Pong。
works.technique: Snap Connected Lenses sync game state and a shared coordinate frame between devices so both players see the same ball and paddles.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Lens Studio Connected Lens 或 Photon 做双人 AR 小游戏；加一个变化：球拍由玩家的脸部位置控制。

works.title: Hot Potato multiplayer lens
works.description: Friends pass a ticking virtual hot potato between their phones in a co-located Snapchat lens until it explodes on someone.
works.idea_zh: 在朋友之间传递会爆炸的虚拟土豆。
works.technique: A connected lens synchronizes ownership of a shared AR object and a countdown timer across participants.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个多人共享的'传炸弹' AR 游戏（Lens Studio 或 Unity Netcode）；加一个变化：只有对着对方手机才能把炸弹扔过去。

works.title: Minecraft remade in AR
works.description: He rebuilt Minecraft mechanics in AR so you can dig into, fight on and build blocks over the real ground around you.
works.idea_zh: 在真实地面上像史蒂夫一样挖、打、建。
works.technique: Real-world meshing aligns a voxel grid to the ground so placed and dug blocks stick to real surfaces (likely Lightship meshing).
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 做一个在地面网格上放方块的建造玩具；加一个变化：方块会被真实阳光方向投下影子。

works.title: Touch Grass lens
works.description: A tongue-in-cheek AR lens detects when you actually touch grass and rewards you, so you can prove online that you go outside.
works.idea_zh: 识别你真的'摸了草'，给你一张出门证明。
works.technique: Hand tracking combined with a ground/grass segmentation or classification model checks that the hand overlaps real grass (likely Lens Studio ML).
works.exercise_zh: 用 Teachable Machine 训练'草地/非草地'分类器，手机拍到手放在草上就发放徽章；加一个变化：换成识别树叶、石头等校园自然物收集图鉴。

works.title: Tony Hawk Pro Skater in AR
works.description: At Venice Beach Skatepark, skaters see AR score popups, trick names and collectibles over their real runs, remaking the video game on real concrete.
works.idea_zh: 把滑板游戏的计分和收集品叠加到真实滑板公园。
works.technique: Collectibles and score UI are anchored in the real park while the skater's motion is tracked relative to them (likely body/camera tracking).
works.exercise_zh: 在操场用 AR 放一串虚拟金币，同学跑步/骑车穿过它们计分；加一个变化：连续穿过三个金币触发'连击'特效。

works.title: Parking-lot kart race
works.description: A mixed-reality game turns any empty parking lot into a Mario Kart-style race track with virtual boosts and items, playable at Two Bit Circus.
works.idea_zh: 把任何停车场变成马里奥赛车跑道。
works.technique: A track, item boxes and boost pads are generated to fit the detected open ground and anchored in world space for players moving through it.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR 在篮球场上画出一条虚拟跑道和加速带，让同学推着椅子比赛；加一个变化：撞到虚拟香蕉皮要原地转一圈。

works.title: Eternal rat prism AR pet
works.description: An internet meme, the spinning rat in a prism, becomes a Snapchat AR pet that follows you around wherever you go.
works.idea_zh: 把网络梗'旋转老鼠棱镜'变成一直跟着你走的 AR 宠物。
works.technique: The pet is re-positioned each frame to trail the camera with smoothing so it appears to follow the user around.
works.exercise_zh: 把一个班级梗做成跟着你走的 AR 宠物（Lens Studio/Reality Composer）；加一个变化：你停下太久它会睡着。

works.title: Spectacles walk RPG
works.description: A Snap Spectacles game made in a weekend turns an everyday walk into an RPG adventure, with monsters and loot appearing along the real path.
works.idea_zh: 戴上眼镜，日常散步变成打怪升级的冒险。
works.technique: World tracking on Spectacles places encounters at intervals along the walked path, and hand tracking is used to fight.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机 AR 做'上学路 RPG'：每走 50 步刷出一个怪，用手势打败它；加一个变化：怪物种类由天气决定。

works.title: Hand-frame photos left in space
works.description: At a Snap AR hackathon his team built a way to take a photo by framing a scene with your fingers and leave that photo floating in place for others to find.
works.idea_zh: 用手指比个取景框拍照，照片就留在原地等别人发现。
works.technique: Hand tracking detects a two-hand frame gesture to crop the camera view, and the image is saved as a persistent anchored object (likely via cloud anchors).
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe 手势识别'双手取景框'来截取摄像头画面；加一个变化：照片被挂在拍摄位置的地图上供全班寻宝。

works.title: Dream Park street access point
works.description: A public Dream Park access point on Santa Monica's Third Street Promenade turns the whole street into a mixed-reality game for passers-by.
works.idea_zh: 在街上装一个'入口'，整条街就变成可下载的混合现实主题乐园。
works.technique: Game content is authored to a specific mapped location so devices localize against it and see the same attractions in the real street.
works.exercise_zh: 给校园设计一条'AR 主题乐园'路线，放三处可玩的 AR 小游戏点（Lens Studio/8th Wall）；加一个变化：只有凑齐三人才能开启最后一个景点。

works.title: DreamPark arcade vending machine
works.description: A DreamPark 'vending machine' installed at Dave & Buster's Hollywood turns the entire arcade floor into a mixed-reality game.
works.idea_zh: 一台'售卖机'把整个电玩城变成混合现实游戏场。
works.technique: A fixed physical kiosk serves as the localization anchor and entry point for location-specific MR content laid over the arcade floor.
works.exercise_zh: 设计一个实体'入口'（海报或纸箱机器），扫码后进入覆盖整个教室的 AR 游戏；加一个变化：入口每天出售不同的'道具'。

works.title: Project Play (Magic Leap)
works.description: A throwback to his Magic Leap app where you could draw, animate and even program objects directly in mixed reality.
works.idea_zh: 在头显里直接画、做动画、甚至编程。
works.technique: Controller-driven 3D drawing strokes become objects that can be keyframed and given simple behaviors in Unity on Magic Leap.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Quest/手机 AR 画 3D 线条，再给线条加一个'跟随我'的行为；加一个变化：两条线相碰时发声。

works.title: Games of Deletion
works.description: A world-scale multiplayer mixed-reality game in which players tag and 'delete' urban art and architecture through their phones, competing over real city spaces.
works.idea_zh: 把城市里的建筑与街头艺术变成多人 AR 游戏里可以'抹除'和争夺的领地。
works.technique: Geolocated AR content is anchored to real urban sites and synced across players so each tag or deletion changes a shared world state.
works.exercise_zh: 在校园选 5 个建筑点，用 AR 给它们'涂鸦'或'擦除'并记录到共享地图上，两队比赛占领；加一个变化：被擦除的建筑在 AR 里真的变透明。

works.title: Interfaces by Morphosis AR app
works.description: The official AR app for Morphosis's Milan Design Week installation with Dassault Systèmes overlays animated architectural geometry and information on the physical installation.
works.idea_zh: 用 AR 给实体建筑装置叠加动态结构和设计信息。
works.technique: Image or object tracking registers the phone to the installation so digital geometry and sound are aligned with the built structure (likely target-based).
works.exercise_zh: 给学校里一件雕塑或建筑模型做一个 AR 导览：扫一扫出现结构线和设计故事；加一个变化：可以'拆开'看内部结构。

works.title: Mistral-OUI: contextual AR UI
works.description: On Magic Leap 2, a vision model recognizes what the wearer is looking at and a language model generates a custom interface for that context, shown floating in view.
works.idea_zh: 看到什么，AI 就当场为你生成对应的界面。
works.technique: Camera frames are captioned by a vision-language model, and an LLM turns the description into HTML UI rendered as a panel in the headset.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机拍一张照片，让多模态大模型识别物体并生成一个'AR 便签' UI（网页 AR 显示）；加一个变化：UI 的风格随物体情绪改变。

works.title: Augmented Inspection (Vision Hack)
works.description: An Apple Vision Pro app lets an operator monitor and teleoperate a Boston Dynamics Spot robot with hand gestures and voice, seeing its camera feed and point cloud in space.
works.idea_zh: 戴上头显，用手势和语音远程巡检、操控机器狗。
works.technique: Hand tracking and speech on Vision Pro drive robot commands, while the robot's camera stream and point cloud are rendered as spatial panels.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机 AR 和一个遥控小车，做'远程巡检'：手机上看到小车摄像头画面并用手势让它转向；加一个变化：发现某种颜色物体时自动标注。

works.title: Charlie Parker memorial Custom Landmarker
works.description: Using Lens Studio's Custom Landmarker, a real Charlie Parker memorial statue is scanned so AR effects wrap precisely around the sculpture on site.
works.idea_zh: 把真实的纪念雕像变成 AR 的'舞台'，特效精确贴合雕像。
works.technique: A pre-scanned 3D model of the statue is used as a tracking target so the lens localizes against the physical monument and aligns effects to it.
works.exercise_zh: 选校园里一座雕塑或门牌，用 Lens Studio Custom Landmarker/8th Wall 做一个贴合它的 AR 特效；加一个变化：特效讲述这件物体的历史。

works.title: National Geographic / NASA JPL Mars AR filter
works.description: Timed with the Perseverance landing, an Instagram AR portal let 220 million followers step into a 360° panorama of Jezero Crater made from images only hours old.
works.idea_zh: 毅力号着陆当天，用最新火星照片做成可走进的 AR 传送门。
works.technique: A world-anchored portal masks a spherical 360° panorama so it is visible only through the door, updated with near-real-time rover imagery.
works.exercise_zh: 用一张真实的 360 全景照（学校、太空、海底）做一扇 AR 传送门；加一个变化：门里的场景每天自动换成新照片。

works.title: 'Wichita' Instagram effect
works.description: An Instagram effect inspired by the White Stripes' 'Seven Nation Army' video splits your face and background into layered, animated kaleidoscopic tunnels.
works.idea_zh: 把自拍变成《Seven Nation Army》MV 那样无限延伸的三角隧道。
works.technique: Person segmentation separates the user from the background, and scripted layers of scaled, offset camera textures create the recursive tunnel.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Spark/Lens Studio 或 p5.js 把摄像头画面做成向中心无限递归的隧道；加一个变化：递归层数随音乐音量变化。

works.title: 'Automaton' Instagram effect
works.description: A face effect that retextures and lights the face mesh to turn the user into a mechanical automaton with layered metal parts.
works.idea_zh: 把你的脸变成机械人偶。
works.technique: A custom texture and normal maps are applied to the tracked face mesh, with additional 3D parts attached to face anchors and lit in real time.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Lens Studio 面部网格贴图，把自己变成'文物'或'机器人'；加一个变化：张嘴时脸上的零件会弹开。

works.title: 'Hole in the head' occlusion effect
works.description: A face-tracked effect cuts a convincing hole into the user's head where a tiny 3D scene sits inside.
works.idea_zh: 在脑袋上开个洞，里面藏着一个小世界。
works.technique: An invisible occluder mesh around the head writes depth only, so a 3D model placed inside appears to sit in a cavity in the face.
works.exercise_zh: 用遮挡（occluder）材质在额头开一个洞，里面放一个旋转的小星球；加一个变化：眨眼时洞里的场景切换。

works.title: Coachella: A Virtual Adventure
works.description: A case study of AR experiences built for Coachella that let festival-goers and remote fans unlock virtual worlds around the event.
works.idea_zh: 为音乐节做一场虚实混合的 AR 探险。
works.technique: Location- and marker-triggered Instagram effects deliver themed AR scenes around the festival (likely world-anchored portals and target tracking).
works.exercise_zh: 为学校活动做一个 AR 寻宝：三个场地各扫出一个虚拟场景，集齐解锁终章；加一个变化：线上观众也能用同一特效参与。

works.title: I/O Brush re-creation (Genuary)
works.description: Re-creating MIT Tangible Media's I/O Brush, a webcam-tracked hand 'picks up' colors and textures from real objects and paints with them on screen.
works.idea_zh: 用手从现实里'蘸取'颜色和纹理，再拿来画画。
works.technique: MediaPipe hand tracking finds the fingertip, samples the camera pixels under it as the brush, then paints strokes into a feedback canvas.
works.exercise_zh: 用 p5.js + MediaPipe Hands，让指尖碰到真实物体时吸取它的颜色，再在空中画画；加一个变化：吸取的是一小段动态视频而不是颜色。

works.title: Echoes
works.description: At Art Basel Miami, each visitor's live pose is matched to the closest pose from previous visitors, so your movement is echoed by people who stood there before you.
works.idea_zh: 你的每个动作，都会召唤出之前某位观众做过的最相似动作。
works.technique: Pose landmarks from a camera are stored per visitor, and a nearest-neighbor search retrieves the closest past pose frame to display alongside the live body.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MoveNet 记录全班同学的姿势库，再让新来的人摆姿势时屏幕显示'最像你的同学'；加一个变化：匹配越准，画面越清晰。

works.title: Immersive Memory (AlUla)
works.description: An interactive installation across three spaces in AlUla's Old Town, a UNESCO site of the incense trade, responds to visitors with visuals and a spatial audio score.
works.idea_zh: 在古城遗址里，观众的身体动作唤起香料之路的记忆影像与空间声音。
works.technique: Camera-based body tracking drives projected generative visuals in each room, tied together by a multichannel spatial audio score (likely MediaPipe/depth tracking).
works.exercise_zh: 为校园一处老建筑做'记忆投影'：人靠近墙面时投影出老照片的粒子；加一个变化：多人同时靠近才能看清完整照片。

works.title: Conducting a virtual choir like Jacob Collier
works.description: Hand gestures tracked from a webcam conduct pitches and harmonies, imitating how Jacob Collier conducts his audience as a choir.
works.idea_zh: 像 Jacob Collier 指挥观众合唱一样，用手势在空中'指挥'和声。
works.technique: Hand landmark height and spread from MediaPipe are mapped to musical pitch and chord voicing, with graphics overlaid on the live camera image.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe Hands + Tone.js：手的高度控制音高，张开程度控制和弦；加一个变化：两个人一起合奏成二重唱。

works.title: MediaPipe body tracking plugin for TouchDesigner
works.description: A free, no-setup webcam plugin tracks face, hands and body in TouchDesigner, shown driving real-time visuals over the performer's body.
works.idea_zh: 零门槛的网页摄像头全身追踪插件，让任何人都能做体感视觉。
works.technique: MediaPipe models run inside an embedded browser in TouchDesigner and stream landmark data as channels to drive visuals.
works.exercise_zh: 用这个插件（或网页版 MediaPipe）做一个'身体乐器'：不同关节碰到屏幕上的区域发出不同音；加一个变化：只有闭眼时才能演奏。

works.title: Hand-tracking watercolor
works.description: Moving your hands in front of a webcam leaves blooming watercolor strokes that bleed and dry over the live image.
works.idea_zh: 在空中挥手，就在画面上晕开水彩。
works.technique: Fingertip positions inject color into a feedback/diffusion shader that simulates pigment spreading and edge darkening.
works.exercise_zh: 用 p5.js 反馈缓冲区 + MediaPipe 指尖做空中水彩；加一个变化：握拳时颜料'干掉'固定下来。

works.title: MakerStudio: sculpting and painting in ARKit
works.description: With an Apple Pencil on an iPad, he sculpts and paints a Halloween creature that stands in the room, using ARKit to walk around and refine it.
works.idea_zh: 用 Apple Pencil 在 iPad 上雕塑、上色，作品直接立在房间里。
works.technique: Pencil strokes deform and paint a mesh while ARKit tracking lets the artist view and edit the sculpture from any angle in real space.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Reality Composer/Adobe Aero 把自己捏的黏土扫描模型放进 AR 并在手机上上色；加一个变化：同学围着模型各自加一笔。

works.title: Multiplayer Paintball in ARKit
works.description: Two iPhones share an ARKit scene and players shoot paintballs that splat on virtual targets and each other.
works.idea_zh: 两部手机共享同一个 AR 空间打彩弹。
works.technique: Devices align their ARKit world origins (likely via a shared starting marker) and sync projectile events over the network.
works.exercise_zh: 用 8th Wall/Lens Studio 多人共享做一个彩弹涂墙游戏，颜料留在真实墙面上；加一个变化：一分钟后涂色面积大的一方获胜。

works.title: Aquila: flying a drone with an AR eagle
works.description: A voice-controlled AR eagle, inspired by Assassin's Creed Origins, acts as the interface to launch and fly a real drone.
works.idea_zh: 用语音召唤一只 AR 老鹰，它带着真实的无人机起飞。
works.technique: Speech commands trigger an animated AR companion whose actions are mapped to drone SDK commands for takeoff and flight.
works.exercise_zh: 用语音识别 + AR 角色控制一个遥控玩具（或 Tello 无人机）：说'起飞'角色先飞、玩具再动；加一个变化：角色会模仿你的手势方向。

works.title: Face substitution tests
works.description: Early openFrameworks tests swap faces in live video, pasting another face onto the tracked face with matching position and expression.
works.idea_zh: 实时把另一张脸'贴'到你的脸上。
works.technique: A face tracker fits a mesh to the live face and texture-maps a second face onto it with color blending (likely based on Kyle McDonald and Arturo Castro's openFrameworks FaceSubstitution code).
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe FaceMesh 把一幅名画的脸贴到自己脸上并跟随表情；加一个变化：两个同学互换脸。

works.title: InstaSaber
works.description: Roll up a piece of paper and the iPhone turns it into a glowing lightsaber that follows the paper tube in your hand.
works.idea_zh: 一卷纸在手机里变成光剑。
works.technique: A custom vision model detects the paper tube's endpoints each frame and a blade mesh with glow is rendered along that line.
works.exercise_zh: 用颜色追踪识别一根彩色吸管/纸筒，在摄像头画面上画出发光剑身（p5.js/OpenCV.js）；加一个变化：两把剑相碰会发出火花和声音。

works.title: YoPuppet
works.description: Hand tracking maps 22 points of your hand onto a cartoon puppet's face, so opening and closing your hand works the puppet's mouth in AR.
works.idea_zh: 把手变成 AR 手偶：张合手掌，木偶就开口说话。
works.technique: A deep-learning hand pose model tracks keypoints in real time and retargets them to a 2D/3D puppet rig anchored over the hand.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe Hands 做'手偶'：拇指和四指的张合控制角色的嘴，并加上变声；加一个变化：两只手的角色可以对话。

works.title: 3D hand interaction and physics on an iPhone
works.description: With only the built-in camera, a tracked 3D hand pushes and knocks over virtual objects that obey physics on a real table.
works.idea_zh: 只用手机摄像头，就能用真手推倒桌上的虚拟积木。
works.technique: A Keras-trained model estimates 3D hand pose, and colliders attached to the hand interact with physics bodies placed on ARKit planes.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Lens Studio 手部追踪或 AR Foundation + 手部碰撞体，让手推倒一排虚拟多米诺；加一个变化：只有竖起食指才能'戳'。

works.title: Mobile hand tracking + ARKit
works.description: An early demo on an iPhone 7 combines 2020CV's own hand tracker with ARKit so a bare hand can interact with AR content.
works.idea_zh: 2017 年就在 iPhone 7 上实现徒手与 AR 物体交互。
works.technique: A custom neural hand detector runs on-device alongside ARKit tracking to map the hand position into the AR scene.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Teachable Machine 训练 3 种手势（张开/握拳/指），在网页 AR 里分别触发出现、抓取、发射；加一个变化：手势序列组成'咒语'。

works.title: SpeakingPuppy
works.description: An iOS app detects your dog's face, puts masks and filters on it and gives it a voice-changed talking mouth.
works.idea_zh: 给狗狗戴上面具，还让它开口说话。
works.technique: A custom pet-face landmark model tracks the dog's face so masks follow it, and the user's recorded voice is pitch-shifted and lip-synced to an animated mouth.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Lens Studio 宠物模板或 Teachable Machine 识别宠物/玩偶的脸，给它配上变声旁白；加一个变化：说话内容由观众打字决定。

works.title: Virtual Drumpad on iOS
works.description: Tapping fingers in the air in front of the phone triggers drum pads that appear over the camera view.
works.idea_zh: 对着空气敲，手机里就响起鼓点。
works.technique: Fingertip tracking detects downward strikes into on-screen pad regions and triggers low-latency audio samples.
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe Hands + 网页音频做空气鼓：指尖进入某个方块就发声；加一个变化：鼓垫会跟着真实桌面边缘排布。

works.title: Face filter from a single photo
works.description: A face filter is generated from one photo of another person and mapped onto the user's live face so it follows expressions.
works.idea_zh: 只用一张照片，就能把别人的脸变成你的实时滤镜。
works.technique: Landmarks from a single photo are used to build a textured face mesh that is warped onto the live tracked face (likely a 2D morphable mapping).
works.exercise_zh: 用 MediaPipe FaceMesh 把一张名人或名画照片做成贴合自己脸的面具；加一个变化：面具只在你笑时出现。

works.title: Body Confetti lens
works.description: A Snapchat lens tracks the full body so bursts of confetti shoot out from the right limbs as you move and dance.
works.idea_zh: 跳舞时彩带从四肢喷出来。
works.technique: Lens Studio body-mesh tracking provides limb positions and velocities that trigger particle emitters attached to the body.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Lens Studio 身体追踪（或 MediaPipe Pose）让挥手时手上喷出彩纸；加一个变化：动作越快彩纸颜色越暖。

works.title: Character Mashup (Lensathon 2022)
works.description: Users custom-build a mashup avatar, bring it to life with body tracking, and share it with friends through connected lenses.
works.idea_zh: 拼一个自己的怪物化身，用身体驱动它，再和朋友同屏互动。
works.technique: Selected body parts are assembled onto a rig driven by full-body tracking, and connected lenses sync avatars between users.
works.exercise_zh: 让学生用纸画出头、身体、腿三部分，拼成一个角色并用 MediaPipe Pose 驱动；加一个变化：和同桌交换一个部件。

works.title: Lenses for Emotional Oranges 'All That'
works.description: Colorful 3D lenses in Velvet Spectrum's signature style transform the performers and scenes of the Emotional Oranges music video.
works.idea_zh: 把工作室的招牌 3D 视觉语言做成音乐 MV 里的 AR 滤镜。
works.technique: Face and world lenses with stylized 3D assets are layered over the performers and shot directly through the camera for the video.
works.exercise_zh: 为一首歌做一个 AR 滤镜 MV：用同一套配色和材质做 3 个不同镜头的滤镜；加一个变化：滤镜随副歌自动切换。

works.title: AR birding guide (Adobe Aero)
works.description: A postcard series for bird-lovers becomes an interactive AR birding guide: illustrated birds fly off the cards and can be explored in 3D.
works.idea_zh: 明信片上的鸟一扫就飞出来，变成可互动的观鸟图鉴。
works.technique: Adobe Aero image anchors recognize each postcard and trigger animated 3D birds with tap behaviors.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Adobe Aero 把学生画的明信片做成 AR 图鉴，扫卡出现 3D 动物和科普文字；加一个变化：两张卡放在一起动物会互动。

works.title: Potato Boss lens
works.description: A Snapchat/Snap Camera lens replaces you with a talking potato whose mouth and eyes are cut from your own face; it went viral when a manager got stuck with it in a video meeting.
works.idea_zh: 把你的脸变成会说话的土豆。
works.technique: Face tracking crops the user's eyes and mouth textures and composites them onto a 3D potato model that follows head pose.
works.exercise_zh: 用 Lens Studio 把眼睛和嘴贴到一个水果/文具上做成'会说话的物品'；加一个变化：讲到关键词时物品会变色。

works.title: Playing Pompidou
works.description: An audio AR lens turns the Centre Pompidou into a musical instrument: visitors 'play' the building's surfaces and compose music from sounds recorded inside the museum.
works.idea_zh: 把整座蓬皮杜中心变成一件可以演奏的乐器。
works.technique: The lens localizes against the building and maps sound samples to architectural elements, so pointing and tapping at parts of the facade triggers and sequences them.
works.exercise_zh: 录下教学楼里的各种声音（门、楼梯、水管），用 AR 把它们贴到对应位置，点哪里就响哪里；加一个变化：把点击顺序录成一段旋律。

works.title: LONELY GHOUSTS
works.description: An early Project Tango AR game in which friendly creatures appear along your real walks and wait to be met and collected.
works.idea_zh: 在日常散步的路上遇见孤单的小幽灵。
works.technique: Tango motion tracking places animated creatures in world space so they stay put as you walk around them.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 在校园路线上随机放置 5 个'孤单小怪'，走近时它们会跟你打招呼；加一个变化：收集后它们会跟在你身后排队。

works.title: Spiders with 6D.ai (Chip Sineni)
works.description: Chip Sineni's creepy-crawly test for the 6D.ai SDK: spiders crawl over and hide behind real furniture thanks to a live mesh of the room.
works.idea_zh: 让虚拟蜘蛛沿着真实家具爬行、躲到后面去。
works.technique: 6D.ai builds a real-time mesh of the environment on the phone, used for occlusion and as a navigation surface so creatures crawl over real geometry.
works.exercise_zh: 用 LiDAR 手机 + AR Foundation Meshing，让一群虚拟小虫沿桌面和椅子爬并被遮挡；加一个变化：开灯（环境光变亮）时它们四散逃跑。

leads.name: Bjarne Lundgren (@bjarnel)
leads.why: Early ARKit prototyper (living-room down-ball tennis, 2017); only third-party mirrors found (youtube.com/watch?v=iGJlroUukaM), no own upload verified.

leads.name: Jonathan Forder
leads.why: AR cartoon prototype at Discover Studios featured by Made With ARKit (youtube.com/watch?v=LYFk25OQJ_8); own channel only has a 2014 AR showreel.

leads.name: Clay Weishaar (Fake Artists)
leads.why: Lens designer behind the meditative 'Metascapes' AR lens; the Snap 'Behind the Lens' video is now private, work lives mostly on Instagram.

leads.name: Shantell Martin
leads.why: Co-created 'Poem World' Spectacles lens with Zach Lieberman (2021); Snap's video (youtube.com/watch?v=gnjUM9LNmEg) has embedding disabled, so no playable video yet.

leads.name: Irene Alvarado & James Paterson
leads.why: NormanAR (2017): frame-by-frame VR animations placed in the world with ARCore/openFrameworks; open source, but no standalone video found.

leads.name: Marpi (Mateusz Marcinowski)
leads.why: SF-based digital artist of reactive creatures (New Nature); co-made the 2017 de Young 'invisible exhibition' ARKit test with Can Büyükberber.

leads.name: Anrick (Spectacles 'Poetry in the Third Dimension')
leads.why: Made an abstract-poetry Spectacles lens about AR as time travel, featured by Lens Studio (youtube.com/watch?v=FgyzVmxoYA4).

leads.name: Paris AR Studio
leads.why: Snap lens studio behind 'Le Louvre Egypt Augmented' and 'Daft Punk: Memories Unlocked' lenses, both with Lens Studio intros/tutorials.

leads.name: Anne Horel
leads.why: French artist making GenAI-driven Snapchat lenses; Lens Studio tutorial feature.

leads.name: Arthur Bouffard
leads.why: Lens creator of 'Furniture Madness' and wellness lenses, featured in Lens Studio tutorials.

leads.name: Xulipa (@_xulipa)
leads.why: Made a wand-duel Spectacles experience that Aidan Wolf highlighted in 2021.

leads.name: Kasimir Lehto
leads.why: Niantic creative behind Rodney Mullen's 'Skatrix' Vision Pro mixed-reality skate app.

leads.name: Dom Scott
leads.why: Co-developer of the MediaPipe plugin for TouchDesigner with Torin Blankensmith; body-tracking visual artist.

leads.name: Runze Zhang
leads.why: Co-author of Games of Deletion (SCI-Arc 2018 Gehry Prize) world-scale AR game with Alessio Grancini.

leads.name: Jye Trudinger
leads.why: Snap lens developer; co-built 'Character Mashup' connected body-tracking lens at Lensathon 2022.

leads.name: Florencia Raffa
leads.why: Lens developer featured in Snap's '10 Devs for 10 Years of Lenses' series.

leads.name: Yegor Ryabtsov
leads.why: Lens developer featured in Snap's '10 Devs for 10 Years of Lenses'; known for technical lens experiments.

leads.name: Don Allen Stevenson III
leads.why: AR creator/educator; 'Dream It Build It: Rift' lens series with Paige Piskin for Snap.
